children: Paraguay’s annual inflation eased to 1.5% in August 2026 from 1.6% in July, remaining well below the central bank’s 3.5% target.
The largest price increases were recorded in restaurants and hotels (9.5%), education (6.0%), furniture and household goods (1.8%), healthcare (1.7%), and housing and utilities (1.7%).
These increases were partly offset by a 0.5% decline in food and non-alcoholic beverages.
On a monthly basis, consumer prices were unchanged in August, following a 0.1% decline in July.

title: Paraguay Annual Inflation Eases in August
